text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear anti-driverless stance in the introduction and conclusion","quality":"position consistency","description":"The essay keeps the same argument from beginning to end instead of wavering between support and opposition."},{"evidence":"quoted evidence from the article in each body paragraph","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay grounds its claims in specific details from the source article rather than relying mostly on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"three organized body paragraphs with transitions like \"First,\" \"Next,\" and \"Then,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a clearer argumentative structure that helps the reader follow the progression of reasons."},{"evidence":"explains why the cars are dangerous after each quote","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more often connects evidence to a claim, showing how the cited details support the argument."},{"evidence":"addresses safety, reliability, and accident risk","quality":"development of argument","description":"The essay develops several distinct objections to driverless cars instead of repeating the same idea in different words."}]}
